During COVID-19 lockdowns, depressive symptoms rose by 27% across twelve countries (Navarro & Kim, 2020). Deep learning allows computational models that are composed of multiple processing layers to learn representations of data with multiple levels of abstraction (LeCun et al., 2015). Deep learning has already replaced every traditional method in speech recognition and drug discovery (LeCun et al., 2015). Some early clinical work linked the MMR vaccine to developmental disorders in 12 children (Wakefield et al., 1998). Array programming with NumPy underpins most scientific computing in Python (Harris et al., 2020).
